'''Lina Zev''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was used as [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo's]] double to throw off [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Javis Tyrr]] so that Solo and [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]]&mdash;whose double was [[Karn Valanti]]&mdash;could escape to a relaxing evening alone together. Dining together at the [[Indigo Tower]], Zev and Valanti entered into light conversation in an attempt to maintain their guises as Solo and Fel respectively. Unfortunately, her impersonation was soon discovered by Tyrr since her mouth and nose differed slightly from those of Solo's. However, the ploy lasted long enough for Solo and Fel to escape to an inn halfway around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], free to dine alone.

Zev, codenamed "Curved," was a member of [[Darkmeld]], a secret organization formed by Solo to undermine [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]]'s [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|anti-Jedi]] policies.

==Behind the scenes==
Lina Zev was created by author [[Christie Golden]] for ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'', her first ''[[Star Wars]]'' novel and the second novel in the nine-part [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series. Zev was later mentioned in a short story by Golden, ''[[Getaway]]'', released in [[Star Wars Insider 134|issue 134]] of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine in [[2012]]. In the story, Zev's surname was misspelled "Zek."
